It is the sequel to ''[[Dark Force Rising]]'' ([[1992]]) and the final volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Thrawn Trilogy]]''. It was first published in hardcover by [[Bantam Spectra]] in [[April]] [[1993]], and it was later adapted into a [[Star Wars: The Last Command (comic series)|''Star Wars: The Last Command'' comic adaptation]].
